D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/.name: D5.S3.Combinatorics.Graph.LinearForests.DirectedForestCompletion.directed_forest_completion
D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/.signature: theorem directed_forest_completion [Finite V] (E : V → V → Prop) (hout : Relator.RightUnique E) (hin : Relator.LeftUnique E) (ha : ∀ x, ¬ TransGen E x x) (hc : 2 ≤ Nat.card (Component E)) : ∃ (q : Component E ≃ Tail E) (h : Component E ≃ Head E) (Φ : CycleCompletion E ≃ FullCycle (Component E)), (∀ A, Quotient.mk (EqvGen.setoid E) (q A).1 = A) ∧ (∀ A, Quotient.mk (EqvGen.setoid E) (h A).1 = A) ∧ (∀ σ A, σ.1 (q A) = h ((Φ σ).1 A)) ∧ Nonempty (CycleCompletion E) ∧ Nat.card (CycleCompletion E) = (Nat.card (Component E) - 1).factorial ∧ UniformCompletionLaw E q h Φ
